# External capture fixtures (VEC-01 / R4)

This directory holds **external** capture fixtures — byte streams captured from
a real third-party DNP3 outstation/stack (or a PCAP export of one), used to
prove the master interoperates with an implementation it did not build.

These are **not** generated by this repository. Each fixture records its
source, capture conditions, and the expected decoded fields, so an independent
reviewer can reproduce the claim.

## Risk addressed

R4 — "No VEC-01 / independent PCAP or third-party stack proof." Until a real
external capture lands here, the external interop claim cannot be made
(`active_work/MEXT_MASTER_ROADMAP.md` MEXT-035 gate).

## Format

Capture fixtures use the format defined in
[`FORMAT.md`](./FORMAT.md) — a line-oriented text file (`.vec`) pairing
metadata with an ordered list of frames (direction + layer + hex bytes), with
an optional PCAP sidecar for raw network capture.

A placeholder sample lives at `sample-vec01-placeholder.vec`.

## Status

Placeholder only (MEXT-020). Real captures land in MEXT-022 (Real-TCP full MVP
path) and MEXT-033 (third-party stack capture), and are referenced by the
external gate `scripts/verify-external-mvp.sh` (MEXT-021).
